ruleDefinitions.name: Program Executed Using Proxy/Local Command Via SSH.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect usage of the "ssh.exe" binary as a proxy to launch other programs.

sequences.query: parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\OpenSSH\\sshd\.exe" OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\ssh\\\.exe$") OR process_product = "OpenSSH\ for\ Windows" OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=55b4964d29aad5438b9e950052dbbbc0.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=334d66c33503ccbf647c15b47c27eef4.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=27b0da080ef92afb37983d30d839141e.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=977eb4c263d384e47daa0712d34713ab.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=3eaadce9ae43d5a918bb082065815c3b.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=980fe6cf0d996ab1eedf877222e722aa.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=5f959422308ac3d721010d66647e100e.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=a49aaa3d03d1cd9c8dc7fca60f7f480b.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=dd335f759b6d5d6a8382b71dd9d65791.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ProxyCommand\\=.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*PermitLocalCommand.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*LocalCommand.*"))))
